from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    counts=Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    bg=counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    specials={v for row in grid for v in row if v not in (0,bg)}
    if not specials: return [r[:] for r in grid]
    color=max(specials,key=lambda v:sum(x==v for row in grid for x in row))
    pts=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,x in enumerate(row) if x==color]
    r0=min(r for r,c in pts); r1=max(r for r,c in pts)
    c0=min(c for r,c in pts); c1=max(c for r,c in pts)
    mask=[(r-r0,c-c0) for r,c in pts]
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for top in range(h-(r1-r0+1)+1):
      for left in range(w-(c1-c0+1)+1):
        vals=[grid[top+dr][left+dc] for dr,dc in mask]
        if all(v in (0,color) for v in vals):
          for dr,dc in mask: out[top+dr][left+dc]=color
    return out

program='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = Counter(value for row in grid for value in row)
    background = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    colors = {value for row in grid for value in row if value not in (0, background)}
    if not colors:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    color = max(colors, key=lambda value: sum(cell == value for row in grid for cell in row))
    points = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, cell in enumerate(row) if cell == color]
    r0, r1 = min(r for r, _ in points), max(r for r, _ in points)
    c0, c1 = min(c for _, c in points), max(c for _, c in points)
    pattern = [(r - r0, c - c0) for r, c in points]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    ph, pw = r1 - r0 + 1, c1 - c0 + 1
    for top in range(h - ph + 1):
        for left in range(w - pw + 1):
            if all(grid[top + dr][left + dc] in (0, color) for dr, dc in pattern):
                for dr, dc in pattern:
                    out[top + dr][left + dc] = color
    return out
'''

program='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = Counter(value for row in grid for value in row)
    background = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    colors = {value for row in grid for value in row if value not in (0, background)}
    if not colors:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    color = max(colors, key=lambda value: sum(cell == value for row in grid for cell in row))
    points = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, cell in enumerate(row) if cell == color]
    r0, r1 = min(r for r, _ in points), max(r for r, _ in points)
    c0, c1 = min(c for _, c in points), max(c for _, c in points)
    pattern = [(r - r0, c - c0) for r, c in points]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    ph, pw = r1 - r0 + 1, c1 - c0 + 1
    for top in range(h - ph + 1):
        for left in range(w - pw + 1):
            if all(grid[top + dr][left + dc] == 0 for dr, dc in pattern):
                for dr, dc in pattern:
                    out[top + dr][left + dc] = color
    return out
'''
